counting: Interface count, not independent engines, actions or benchmark tasks.

tools.name: eda_xsim
tools.description: Compile Verilog/SystemVerilog and VHDL, elaborate a testbench and run bounded XSim. Supports include directories, defines, top parameters, libraries, plusargs and SV seed. Optional literal pass_marker yields an explicit verdict; fatal/error/timeout overrides it. Without a marker functional acceptance remains unevaluated.

tools.name: eda_vivado
tools.description: Execute an authored Vivado Tcl script in a new output directory. Set EDA_WORKSPACE to the project root for resolving inputs. Supports synthesis and implementation; returns artifacts and logs, not an assumed pass verdict.

tools.name: eda_ltspice_batch
tools.description: Run a self-contained .cir/.net netlist with the real LTspice batch engine and return its .log measurements. Copies the input into a fresh artifact directory. For external models use absolute .include paths or the official LTspice MCP in the original project directory.

tools.name: eda_verify
tools.description: Check the provided counter and RC examples against fixed behavioral and mathematical acceptance criteria. Accepts artifact directory paths and one combined analog log. The result is computed independently of the model.

tools.name: eda_vivado_catalog
tools.description: Query the installed Vivado version, available commands, parts or IP VLNVs. Bounded results include total match count; availability is not execution proof.

tools.name: eda_vivado_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesize explicit RTL/XCI sources and XDC into a fresh checkpoint. Supports include directories, defines and top parameters. Defaults to out-of-context; no implicit clocks or timing relaxation. Produces utilization and black-box evidence.

tools.name: eda_vivado_implement
tools.description: Open a synthesis checkpoint, optionally apply explicit additional XDC, and run opt/place/route in a fresh directory. Returns routed DCP, timing, route and constraint evidence. Tool completion is separate from timing closure or board signoff.

tools.name: eda_vivado_reports
tools.description: Generate selected timing, CDC, DRC, methodology, clock, exception, route and utilization reports from a checkpoint. Unknown report formats remain unknown; CDC warnings and missing IO constraints require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_objects
tools.description: Inspect bounded matching cells, nets, ports, pins or clocks in a checkpoint. Returns names and selected properties plus total count; query text is passed as data, never evaluated as Tcl.

tools.name: eda_vivado_timing_paths
tools.description: Return setup or hold timing paths with endpoint, slack, requirement and logic depth. Optional from/to clock names must resolve exactly. A bounded path listing does not establish whole-design TNS or signoff.

tools.name: eda_vivado_find_parts
tools.description: Find installed parts; starts Vivado, returns bounded matches.

tools.name: eda_vivado_find_ips
tools.description: Find installed ips; starts Vivado, returns bounded matches.

tools.name: eda_vivado_find_commands
tools.description: Find installed commands; starts Vivado, returns bounded matches.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_timing
tools.description: Generate timing evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_utilization
tools.description: Generate utilization evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_cdc
tools.description: Generate cdc evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_drc
tools.description: Generate drc evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_methodology
tools.description: Generate methodology evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_clocks
tools.description: Generate clocks evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_exceptions
tools.description: Generate exceptions evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_report_route
tools.description: Generate route evidence from an immutable input DCP in a fresh run. Report warnings require review.

tools.name: eda_vivado_query_cells
tools.description: Query cells with bounded output and total count. Patterns are Tcl data.

tools.name: eda_vivado_query_nets
tools.description: Query nets with bounded output and total count. Patterns are Tcl data.

tools.name: eda_vivado_query_ports
tools.description: Query ports with bounded output and total count. Patterns are Tcl data.

tools.name: eda_vivado_query_pins
tools.description: Query pins with bounded output and total count. Patterns are Tcl data.

tools.name: eda_vivado_query_clocks
tools.description: Query clocks with bounded output and total count. Patterns are Tcl data.

tools.name: eda_vivado_setup_paths
tools.description: Inspect worst setup paths. This is not whole-design signoff.

tools.name: eda_vivado_hold_paths
tools.description: Inspect worst hold paths. This is not whole-design signoff.

tools.name: eda_vivado_optimize
tools.description: Provider-free RouteAgents routing plus bounded Vivado candidate loop and AER plateau stopping. Default plan measures a routed DCP; run tries physical recipes. resume_from continues an interrupted run from a verified committed journal in a fresh directory after baseline/winner remeasurement; run recovery-check first. Preserves constraints, logical representation, routing/hold/DRC gates; reports gain and rejections. No formal/board signoff. Shared lease and causal traces.

resume_from.description: Native interrupted optimizer run directory. Continues in a fresh run after ownership/hash checks and independent remeasurement.

tools.execution_note: Both plan and run launch Vivado

tools.name: eda_knowledge
tools.description: Rank local FPGA rules using English terms and Chinese bigrams, or retrieve an exact rule ID. Returns source versions, applicability, required evidence and corpus hashes. Lexical retrieval only; no embeddings, model or internet call.

tools.name: eda_sop
tools.description: List local FPGA SOPs or load one by ID with its full procedure, referenced rules, required evidence and file hashes. Guidance is advisory; declared workflow checks enforce acceptance. No EDA or model call.

tools.name: eda_trace
tools.description: Offline inspect, recovery-check or OTLP JSON export for native/proxy/optimizer traces. Checks hashes, parents, committed state and ownership. Export writes a local file only; never uploads, resumes EDA or infers functional acceptance.

tools.name: eda_runs
tools.description: List persistent runtime jobs. Explicit reconcile archives leases only when their owner and recorded children are absent; never kills or reruns a job.

tools.name: eda_preflight
tools.description: Inspect local EDA capability paths, runtime configuration and model API policy. Availability is not a successful validation.

tools.name: eda_benchmark
tools.description: List, plan, execute, report or compare versioned local benchmarks. Real EDA runs use global resource limits, frozen acceptance and per-case traces. Seeds are variants, not independent tasks.

tools.name: eda_trace_inspect
tools.description: Inspect hashes, span lineage and terminal evidence; no EDA execution.

tools.name: eda_trace_export
tools.description: Export terminal spans to a local OTLP JSON file; no upload.

tools.name: eda_trace_recovery_check
tools.description: Check durable optimizer recovery eligibility and process ownership; does not resume.

tools.name: eda_runs_list
tools.description: Read persistent run states and counts.

tools.name: eda_runs_reconcile
tools.description: Release stale leases only after owner and child processes are absent; never terminate a process.

tools.name: eda_benchmark_list
tools.description: List cases and execution prerequisites.

tools.name: eda_benchmark_plan
tools.description: Resolve a frozen campaign without starting EDA.

tools.name: eda_benchmark_run
tools.description: Execute a frozen campaign with shared leases and per-case receipts; starts EDA.

tools.name: eda_benchmark_report
tools.description: Read a retained campaign; failures and timeouts remain in the denominator.

tools.name: eda_benchmark_compare
tools.description: Compare campaigns only when case acceptance and test inputs are compatible.

tools.name: eda_results_list
tools.description: List retained historical scorecards with original protocols and units. Does not run EDA.

tools.name: eda_results_get
tools.description: Read one historical scorecard, limitations and public/original evidence hashes.

tools.name: eda_results_verify
tools.description: Verify packaged evidence hashes and available local originals. Missing original artifacts are reported, never treated as reproduced.

tools.name: eda_results_compare
tools.description: Compare historical scores only if task population, protocol, scope, units and evidence integrity match.

tools.name: eda_workflow_plan
tools.description: Resolve a frozen sequential task, input hashes, tool dependencies and budget without starting EDA.

tools.name: eda_workflow_run
tools.description: Execute declared steps with shared tool leases, fixed acceptance checks and a cumulative budget. May start EDA. Stops on the first failed check.

tools.name: eda_workflow_inspect
tools.description: Read task checkpoints and verify committed child traces, result files and output hashes.

tools.name: eda_workflow_resume_check
tools.description: Read-only check of task ownership, frozen inputs, implementation, completed results and remaining budget.

tools.name: eda_workflow_resume
tools.description: Continue an eligible task in a new trace, reusing verified completed steps. An interrupted uncommitted step is rerun; no exactly-once guarantee. May start EDA.

tools.name: eda_task_context
tools.description: Prepare ranked rules, phase-selected SOPs and their actual tool contracts. Optionally revalidate a workflow and attach domain outcomes, evidence citations and recovery advice. No model or EDA execution.
